recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It restores the seed's missing curation guidance without altering the later FHIR-29968 conformance algorithm; no further core source work is indicated for FHIR-7592.
issue_request: FHIR-7592 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue asking that extensible binding guidance prevent value-set gaps from persisting: when a suitable value-set code does not exist, alternate codes or text may be used, identified value-set gaps should be submitted to the organization administering the value set, and CodeableConcept text should support human-readable meaning.
initial_application: The issue was originally applied by svn revision 5710, now git commit 3cadeb2ffced5a33ea077113bc975cf9114bb86e, which changed source/terminologies.html to add CodeableConcept and Coding-specific extensible-binding guidance plus the gap submission sentence. Current source retained and later refined the alternate-code/text mechanics, and current source/datatypes.html already explains CodeableConcept text and free-text-only representation.
additional_context: Later issues FHIR-16333, FHIR-17402, and especially FHIR-29968 substantially rewrote the same extensible-binding section. FHIR-29968 was reviewed in May 2022 by Vocabulary with MnM and FHIR-I participation and introduced the current three-case conformance algorithm; that rewrite removed the FHIR-7592 gap submission sentence, but the Jira/minutes trail focused on conformance behavior and did not supersede the seed's value-set curation guidance.
reconciliation: Added a narrow paragraph to source/terminologies.html after the current extensible-binding algorithm: identified gaps in value sets should be submitted to the organization administering the value set to improve future interoperability. No datatype source change was made because CodeableConcept text guidance is already present.
source_changes: source/terminologies.html: restored value-set-gap submission guidance immediately after the extensible-binding alternate-code/text algorithm.
